name: track-changents
description: Editor-agnostic track-changes core: a clean file on disk + a sidecar JSON store, with the diff / per-author blame / comment anchors / accept-reject all DERIVED purely at read time, plus the agent edit/comment/reply CLIs and a PreToolUse guard hook for Claude Code. Editor hosts (an Obsidian plugin, a VS Code extension) read/write the identical sidecar, so this is a cross-tool contract.
